Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — security checklist items

Thanks for the demo today — appreciate the concise walkthrough. Quick follow-ups from our security/compliance team:

- Can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report or a delivery window? We need the attestation for our risk review.
- Is a bridge letter available if the full report is under NDA?
- We also need temporary trust portal access or a secure SFTP to drop requested artifacts.
- We'll start the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) and can send over a preview.

We'd like to keep this on a tight timeline (two-week intake ideally). Priya

Hi Priya — great to meet you earlier. Recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap:
- Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for our inference platform (covering control period through 2026-06-30).
- We have a standard bridge letter we can provide while export of the full report proceeds under NDA.
- Trust portal (Redwood TrustHub) can be provisioned with read-only view and timeboxed keys for your team.

Proposed next steps: (1) I will initiate a secure intake and provision TrustHub access for two named reviewers, (2) Marissa will share the VSQ template and a short intake checklist, (3) Aditya will be available for any technical artifact requests.

Please confirm the two reviewer emails and whether you prefer TrustHub or an SFTP drop. We can target the two-week intake you suggested; we typically expect doc upload + one short Q&A call in that window.

Attachments I can send now: a redacted SOC 2 summary and our VSQ prefill to speed the process.

Thanks,
Irene

Preference: TrustHub would be ideal — read-only access for the two reviewers and a 14-day window. If TrustHub provisioning takes >48 hours, we can accept an SFTP temporary drop instead.

Tom

Tom / Priya — thanks for confirming reviewers. Quick status update and kickoff plan: 

1) TrustHub provisioning: I created the tenant request and set reviewers to tom.ellis@kestrelhealth.com and gita.patel@kestrelhealth.com. You should see an invite at the TrustHub link below — access will be read-only and expires in 14 days.
   - Trust link: https://trust.redwood.ai/tenant/kestrel-1234

2) Artifacts: to avoid common delays, please prioritize these items in your intake:
   - SOC 2 Type II report (PDF, redacted if necessary) or attestation date range
   - Encryption key management documentation (KMS/HSM vendor + rotation cadence)
   - Access control lists and onboarding/offboarding runbook excerpts
   - Network segmentation diagram (high level) and any egress controls

3) Attached: initial VSQ prefill (kestrel_vsq_v1.pdf) and a lightweight manifest (rdl_secure_manifest.csv) listing preferred filenames/paths for TrustHub.

4) Next handshake: Marissa will reach out to schedule a short 20-min intake call tomorrow (Thu) to walk through the upload process and any expected redactions. Aditya will stand by for artifact-specific questions.

If any change to reviewers is needed, reply-all and we'll adjust.

Best,
Irene

Attachments:
- kestrel_vsq_v1.pdf (Vendor Security Questionnaire prefill, 12 pages)
- rdl_secure_manifest.csv (CSV manifest: filename, expected type, notes)
